log.msg: built Server/StaleClose.mjs (--plan/--apply/--undo, class StaleClose, one constant HOURS=24) in worktree stale-close, commit b878752be; plan against the real state: 437 stale, 370 planned (105 aged 1-7 d, 265 older), 67 skipped as under 24 h, 0 waiting, 0 with a live agent. in_flight rows can never qualify: the state calls a task in_flight only when a working agent holds its dir, so the plan reads stale only.

decision.msg: undo appends `start`, not `resume`: CAN.resume is paused-only, so a resume after stop is refused and the task stays stopped; start (CAN.start has stopped) puts it back to running. Checked on all 370 planned logs by folding lines+stop and lines+stop+start: stopped>running for every one. Alternative rejected: editing Task.js (fenced).
